facts.material: unvulcanized synthetic rubber (description also mentions natural forms)

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 4002 covers synthetic rubber in primary forms; chapter 40 note 1, 3, 4 define rubber and primary forms and do not exclude
GRI 6: 4002.99 other synthetic rubber (polymer type not stated; not BR, IIR, IR, EPDM, SBR)

rejected_alternatives.reason: described as synthetic rubber, not natural rubber

missing_facts: Actual polymer type (SBR, BR, IR, etc.) and whether the goods are natural rubber (heading 4001) rather than synthetic; description is internally inconsistent
classification.rationale: Unvulcanized synthetic rubber in primary forms falls in heading 4002 under GRI 1 with chapter 40 notes 3-4; without the polymer type the residual 4002.99 line is the best guess. The mention of natural forms could instead point to heading 4001.
